summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Pleasant Ridge Union School District to issue $19,800,000 in general obligation bonds, repaid by a property tax of about $22.50 per $100,000 of assessed value, to fund repairs and improvements to school facilities.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes bonds and an associated property-tax levy to fund improvements to local schools.
tax.quote: authorizing $19,800,000 in bonds, levying approximately $22.50 per $100,000 assessed value, generating on average $1,400,000, annually, while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A Yes vote provides bond funding for improvements to the district’s elementary and middle schools.
schools.quote: To update local elementary and middle schools, replace leaky roofs and failing heating/cooling systems, improve student and school safety, weatherproof schools to avoid mold and dry rot, and qualify for matching funds from the State

tax.text: A No vote does not authorize the proposed bonds or associated property-tax levy.
tax.quote: authorizing $19,800,000 in bonds, levying approximately $22.50 per $100,000 assessed value, generating on average $1,400,000, annually, while bonds are outstanding

schools.text: A No vote does not provide the proposed bond funding for improvements to the district’s schools.
